'''Microwave 1-2-3 cake''' is a quick and easy sweet cake recipe made in the [[Cookbook:Microwave Oven|microwave]]. This recipe is quite forgiving in proportions: careful measurement is not required.

==Ingredients==

* 1 [[cookbook:egg|egg]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoon]] [[cookbook:honey|honey]] or [[Cookbook:Maple Syrup|maple syrup]]
* 2 tablespoons [[cookbook:milk|milk]]
* 3 tablespoons [[Cookbook:Bread Crumb|bread crumbs]]
==Procedure==

# [[Cookbook:Beating|Beat]] the egg until smooth.
# Add the honey and milk and mix well.
# Add the breadcrumbs and mix until uniform.
# Let the mixture sit for a few minutes, to allow the breadcrumbs to absorb the moisture.
# Pour the mixture into a small silicone mold (e.g. Dollar store loaf pan).
# Microwave on high for 4 minutes or a little after it stops rising.
# Allow to cool a little; tip out onto a plate if desired.
# Top with more maple syrup or honey, if desired.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* Tip: coat the measuring spoon with oil before putting the honey in, so that it slides off easily and doesn't stick to the spoon.
